07FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about enquiries, appliances and booking.

Ask on WhatsApp
How do I book a service?

Fill in the enquiry form, send us a WhatsApp message or call +91 8939115649. We will talk through what you need and confirm a visit with you.

Is my visit confirmed when I send the form?

Not yet. The form sends us your details. We then contact you to check availability at your location and agree on a time.

Which appliances do you work on?

Kitchen chimneys (wall mounted, island and cylinder), water heaters (storage and instant) and built in kitchen hobs.

Do you service all brands?

We are an authorised Elica service company and also service Racold water heaters and Butterfly chimneys. For other brands, send us the brand and model and we will let you know.

What should I share when I get in touch?

The appliance, its brand and model if you know them, what is wrong or what you need, and your location. A photo on WhatsApp helps too.

How much does a service cost?

It depends on the appliance, the model and the work involved. Send us the details and we will discuss the price with you.
